projects.title: Team B.E.E.R.
projects.description:
Team B.E.E.R. is a custom web component library that features a mixture of raw custom elements and elements built using LitElement. The library contains brand, button, nav, and notification elements. All of the elements within the library can be stylized using custom CSS or bootstrap for further personalization.

As a QA engineer for our team, I worked with Mocha, Chai, and TestCafe for testing, Gulp for minifying, and NPM for publishing our product for all to use. Additionally, our team worked with Travis CI for our build pipeline.
